Under the influence of its outer subsiding air, the weather will be generally fine and extremely hot over southern China. High temperatures will also trigger thundery showers. A southwesterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong midweek next week. High temperature weather is expected to continue and there will also be a few showers over the region.
